# package discovery

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/discovery"
```

Package discovery finds KNXnet/IP servers (SEARCH\_REQUEST, multicast or directed unicast, standard or extended) and reads their self description (DESCRIPTION\_REQUEST).

Search sends one request (or a few, see WithRepeat) and collects the answers until the timeout: it is not a scanner. Multicast discovery needs a network that carries 224.0.23.12 between the client and the servers; many container, VPN and cloud networks do not, so a directed search (WithUnicast) or Describe of a known address is the fallback.

## Constants

```go
const DefaultMaxResults = 256
```

DefaultMaxResults is the number of servers Search returns at most unless WithMaxResults sets another.

```go
const DefaultTimeout = 3 * time.Second
```

DefaultTimeout is the default collection time of a search (SEARCH\_TIMEOUT of the standard is 10 s; servers answer within a few hundred milliseconds on a LAN).

## Functions

### func Describe

```go
func Describe(ctx context.Context, addr string, opts ...Option) (knxnetip.DIBs, error)
```

Describe sends a DESCRIPTION\_REQUEST to the server at addr and returns the DIBs of its response. The request is sent up to three times within the timeout.

## Types

### type Option

```go
type Option func(*options) error
```

Option configures Search and Describe.

#### func WithExtended

```go
func WithExtended(params ...knxnetip.SearchParam) Option
```

WithExtended sends SEARCH\_REQUEST\_EXTENDED (KNXnet/IP core v2) with the given search parameters. Servers that only know the core v1 services do not answer it.

#### func WithInterface

```go
func WithInterface(name string) Option
```

WithInterface sends multicast searches on the named network interface and announces its address.

#### func WithLocalAddr

```go
func WithLocalAddr(addr string) Option
```

WithLocalAddr binds the socket to a local address.

#### func WithLogger

```go
func WithLogger(l knx.Logger) Option
```

WithLogger sets the logger.

#### func WithMaxResults

```go
func WithMaxResults(n int) Option
```

WithMaxResults sets how many distinct servers Search collects (1 or more; DefaultMaxResults without it). Search returns as soon as it has that many: a flood of answers does not grow memory.

#### func WithNAT

```go
func WithNAT(on bool) Option
```

WithNAT announces the route back endpoint 0.0.0.0:0, for clients behind NAT (directed search and describe only).

#### func WithRepeat

```go
func WithRepeat(n int) Option
```

WithRepeat sends the search n times (1..3), one second apart, for lossy networks.

#### func WithTimeout

```go
func WithTimeout(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithTimeout sets how long answers are collected (Search) or awaited (Describe).

#### func WithUnicast

```go
func WithUnicast(addr string) Option
```

WithUnicast sends the search to one server instead of the multicast group: a directed search, answered by servers that support it. Search then returns as soon as the server answered.

### type Result

```go
type Result struct {
	// From is the source of the response datagram.
	From netip.AddrPort
	// Control is the control endpoint the server announced.
	Control knxnetip.HPAI
	// Extended is set for a SEARCH_RESPONSE_EXTENDED.
	Extended bool
	DIBs     knxnetip.DIBs
}
```

Result is one server found by Search.

#### func Search

```go
func Search(ctx context.Context, opts ...Option) ([]Result, error)
```

Search sends a search request and returns the servers that answered within the timeout, ordered by endpoint. It returns an empty slice, not an error, when none answered.

#### func (Result) Device

```go
func (r Result) Device() knxnetip.DeviceInfo
```

Device returns the DEVICE\_INFO block.

#### func (Result) Endpoint

```go
func (r Result) Endpoint() netip.AddrPort
```

Endpoint returns the address to connect to: the announced control endpoint, or the source of the response when the server announced the route back endpoint.

#### func (Result) Services

```go
func (r Result) Services() knxnetip.ServiceFamilies
```

Services returns the supported service families.
